==English==

===Etymology 1===
(early 17th century) From a [[Romance language]], see {{cog|fr|concentrer}}, {{cog|it|concentrare|concentràre}}, {{cog|es|concentrar}}; alternatively from {{bor|en|la-med|-}}/{{der|en|la-new|concentrō}} + {{af|en|-ate|id1=verb|pos1=verb-forming suffix}}. Compare also earlier {{doublet|en|concentre|notext=1}} and {{cog|de|konzentrieren}}. {{surf|en|con-|center|-ate|pos2=centr- in compounds|id3=verb|pos3=verb-forming suffix}}.

====Pronunciation====
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒn.sən.tɹeɪt/|a=UK}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-concentrate.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɑn.sən.tɹeɪt/|a=US,Atlantic Canada}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈkɒn.sən.tɹeɪt/|a=CA,Boston,Maine}}

====Verb====
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|ergative}} To bring to, or direct toward, a common [[center]]; to [[unite]] more closely; to gather into one body, mass, or force.
#: ''to '''concentrate''' rays of light into a focus''
#: ''to '''concentrate''' the attention''
# To [[increase]] the [[strength]] and diminish the bulk of, as of a liquid or an ore; to intensify, by getting rid of useless material; to [[condense]].
#: {{antonyms|en|dilute}}
#: ''to '''concentrate''' acid by evaporation''
#: ''to '''concentrate''' by washing''
# To approach or meet in a common center; to [[consolidate]].
#: {{ux|en|Population tends to '''concentrate''' in cities.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2006|author=w:Edwin Black
|title=Internal Combustion
|chapter=2|url=http://openlibrary.org/works/OL4103950W
|passage=Buried within the Mediterranean littoral are some seventy to ninety million tons of slag from ancient smelting, about a third of it '''concentrated''' in Iberia. This ceaseless industrial fueling caused the deforestation of an estimated fifty to seventy million acres of woodlands.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[focus]] one's [[thought]] or [[attention]] (on).
#: {{syn|en|think|bury|}} (oneself)
#: {{ux|en|Let me '''concentrate'''!}}

===Etymology 2===
From {{bor|en|la-med|-}}/{{bor|en|la-new|concentrātus}}, {{glossary|perfect}} {{glossary|passive}} {{glossary|participle}} of {{m|la-new|concentrō||concentate}}. See [[#Etymology 1|Etymology 1]] and {{af|en|-ate|id1=adjective|pos1=adjective-forming suffix}} for more.

====Adjective====
{{en-adj}}

# [[concentrated]]

===Etymology 3===
From a [[substantivation]] of the above [[adjective]]. See also {{af|en|-ate|id1=substantive|pos1=noun-forming suffix}}. Compare {{cog|fr|concentré}} and {{cog|de|Konzentrat}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# A substance that is in a condensed form.
#: {{ux|en|orange '''concentrate'''}}
